scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=cjs --outfile=dist/index.js --minify-whitespace && cd dist && rm -f function.zip && zip -q function.zip index.js
scripts.deploy: aws lambda update-function-code --function-name stempath-daily-opportunities --zip-file fileb://dist/function.zip --region us-east-1 --profile stempath --no-cli-pager --query '{Function:FunctionName,State:State,Size:CodeSize}'
scripts.test:invoke: aws lambda invoke --function-name stempath-daily-opportunities --cli-binary-format raw-in-base64-out --cli-read-timeout 0 --payload '{"trigger":"manual-test","limit":5}' --region us-east-1 --profile stempath --no-cli-pager /tmp/lambda-out.json && cat /tmp/lambda-out.json
